# Getting help

- **Questions about data quality or using the Commons:** ask in [Discussions, Q&A](https://github.com/cyberdudeuk/dq-commons/discussions/new?category=q-a).
- **Anything else, including accessibility problems:** use the [contact form](https://github.com/cyberdudeuk/dq-commons/issues/new?template=0-contact.yml). It is the only way to reach the team; we never publish an email address.
- **A security problem:** report it privately, as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), never in a public issue.
- **How to use the portal:** the [user guide](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/dq-commons/guide.html) has guided tours and answers to common questions.

We aim to reply within 5 working days, and within 1 working day for accessibility problems ([service levels](../docs/MODERATION.md)).
